records.geometry: Source inventory includes mines/refineries/oil-gas fields/mills; candidate LHA tables reference selected normalized values.
records.vintage: Source vintages differ; file names and candidate status do not establish current industrial operations.
records.rights: NRCan/BC/source-specific terms and original source labels need direct review.
mapNow: Specific independently sourced site geometry may support an environmental context overlay.
missing: Verify exact original source, operational status, coordinates and emission/remediation definitions.
Retain candidate/source-equivalence flags and reviewed aggregation.
cannot: Industrial site presence is not measured pollution, personal exposure, toxic dose or causal disease risk.

records.title: Terrain, hillshade and flatten/visibility dependencies
records.grain: DEM tile or modelled viewing station/route; rendered hillshade is not an observation table.
records.geometry: Remote AWS Terrarium raster DEM and local hillshade; PG/SF graphs are separate routing inputs assigned to the access audit.
records.vintage: DEM mosaic edition/resolution depends on source/zoom; PG flatten source has OSM/elevation hashes and stated terrain estimates.
records.rights: AWS terrain/source DEM and graph-engine/OSM licences need separate retention; do not infer a single licence from toolkit code.
mapNow: PGMaps already has terrain/visibility specialist renderers; source DEM availability was not fetched here.
missing: NHHR currently lacks analytical raster DEM/terrain, tile decoding and worker/visibility model interfaces.
Keep missing terrain unknown, source resolution and coordinate registration explicit.
Visibility/access models need their own reviewer assumptions and data coverage.
cannot: Terrain-only visibility is not cellular signal or guaranteed accessibility.
Regional terrain is not LiDAR; bridges/tunnels and missing turn restrictions limit route interpretations.
records.next: Link the existing specialist tool first; add terrain only for a concrete environmental/access question with preserved resolution, licence and modelling assumptions.
records.verificationScope: Terrain/source documentation and flatten provenance schema inspected; raster pixels and graph/model outputs not audited.

records.rights: Google My Maps/archival/contributor rights not established by the local KML copy.

missing: Keep historical period, approximate accuracy and provenance with every feature.

records.next: Keep outside the clinical Atlas unless a clearly historical research story needs it; link the archival source and mark approximate points.
records.verificationScope: Summary counts/description inspected; original archival location accuracy and individual records unreviewed.

records.title: Nechako public research and GIS service showcase
records.grain: Public research record/location reference, bibliography entry or WMS service/layer metadata; these grains lack a verified common ID crosswalk.
records.geometry: 1,408 research records; 51 location IDs, 46 mapped locations, 365 unmapped records; 32 WMS services and 135 named layers are catalogue entries.
records.vintage: Public capture 11 October 2026; saved public projects captured 12 October 2026. Research dates span 12 decades.
records.rights: Each research attachment, WMS service and bibliography source retains its own rights; public metadata is not a universal GIS-data licence.
mapNow: Public research-reference points and source links can support a separate literature/location explorer.
missing: Verify research-location definitions and deduplicate original identities before joining to NHHR study evidence.
WMS capabilities are metadata; data layers/identify depend on live services and a missing NHHR WMS adapter.
No verified crosswalk exists among research IDs, Zotero keys and portal submission IDs.
cannot: Mapped literature references are not clinical trial sites, participant locations or completed NHHR research.
Named WMS layers do not establish locally available scientific rows.
records.next: Offer a linked regional research-source catalogue first; only add a bounded public location/reference table after identity and rights review.
records.verificationScope: Manifest counts/limitations inspected; WMS services, attachments and underlying portal GIS databases not fetched; private submissions were excluded upstream.
